purpose: Replace flat V1 Hyperfocus ambient choices with six environmental sound families, each with soft/deep/intense levels, without allowing music-like outputs.

sourcePolicy.preferredSource: free real-world nature recordings bundled in public/sounds/hyperfocus
sourcePolicy.aiGenerationPolicy: Generated pilots stay quarantined until objective QC and audible review prove they are non-musical, loop-safe environmental beds.
disallowedAudioTraits: artist references or pop/music genre steering
vocals, spoken words, lyrics, whispering, or humming
melody, beat, drums, instruments, hooks, risers, drops, intros, or outros
sudden alarms, notification-like transients, clipping, harsh peaks, or scare moments
social chatter as a visible V2 nature-family option

assetPolicy.loudness: quiet focus bed; no clipping; no harsh transient spikes; no fatigue after 10 minutes looped

fullPackAllowedOnlyAfter: source license and local bundled path are recorded
afinfo probe confirms readable MP3 duration and sample rate
manifest sha256 and bytes match local files
objective size/duration/loop-safety checks pass or are explicitly marked REVIEW_REQUIRED
audible review confirms no song, melody, beat, vocals, intelligible speech, or fatigue-inducing spikes

families.label: Underwater focus
families.focusRole: soft pressure cocoon that masks distraction without music

levels.label: Shallow Drift
levels.prompt: Generate a 30-second seamless loop, field-recording environmental soundscape for concentration. This is a nature soundscape, not a song. Scene: gentle underwater room tone, soft muffled bubbles, slow pressure drift, no machinery. Level: soft, sparse, low movement, almost meditative. Keep the texture steady from first second to last second. No vocals, no lyrics, no melody, no beat, no drums, no instruments, no song structure. No intro, no ending, no riser, no dramatic transition, no scored drama. Make it calm, local, organic, loop-safe, and suitable for long focus sessions.
rejectIf: contains vocals, lyrics, spoken words, whispering, humming, or human singing
contains melody, tune, motif, hook, arpeggio, or recognizable musical phrase
contains beat, drums, percussion, pulse, rhythm section, or metronomic groove
contains instruments, synth pads, bassline, piano, guitar, strings, brass, or lead sound
contains song structure, chorus, verse, drop, intro, outro, riser, or transition
sounds like pop or commercial music soundtrack instead of environmental ambience
does not form a clean seamless loop or has an obvious seam, fade-in, or fade-out
has clipping, harsh transient, click, pop, alarm, siren, notification, or distracting spike
